detail.gitMissing: git was not found on PATH

hint.gitWindows: Install Git for Windows (https://git-scm.com/download/win) or `winget install Git.Git`, then restart Orkestr.
hint.gitMac: Run `xcode-select --install` or `brew install git`, then restart Orkestr.
hint.gitLinux: Install git with your package manager (e.g. `sudo apt install git`), then restart Orkestr.
hint.shell: Install PowerShell 7 (`winget install Microsoft.PowerShell`) or make sure cmd/bash is available.
hint.dataDirWritable: Check folder permissions or set ORKESTR_HOME to a writable folder.
hint.dataDirSpace: Free up disk space: snapshots and worktrees need room.
hint.webviewWindows: Install the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124703).
hint.webviewLinux: Install WebKitGTK 4.1 (`libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0`) for the desktop app.
hint.webviewHeadless: Not required for a headless core.
hint.keyringFailed: API keys cannot be stored securely until the credential store works; an encrypted file vault is used as fallback.
